Parents who choose Nathien usually hope their child will grow to embody given by god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_latin.name: Nathien

in_english.name: Nathien
in_english.meaning: servant of God; Christian; servant of the Lord
in_english.long_meaning: The name Nathien originates from the Hebrew root אעבל בל הליית עלרי, meaning servant or slave. In the biblical context, Nathien means servant of the Lord or Christian. In early Christian tradition, Nathien was used as a name for a servant or a follower of Christ. The name Nathien is a symbol of devotion, loyalty, and faithfulness to God. It represents one who serves the Lord with humility and dedication. In modern Christian cultures, Nathien is used as a given name, symbolizing a strong faith and commitment to one's spiritual journey.
